runtime_cases.accepted_template: The exact selected GGUF runs only with its Jinja template, --reasoning off, deterministic sampling, one stdin/stdout child, and no listener.
runtime_cases.unicode_and_locale: Each active locale is serialized as UTF-8 with its exact locale code. The worker does not translate, merge, or fall back to another locale.
runtime_cases.bounded_output: Each real probe requires nonempty UTF-8 display text with no <think> tag. The explicit 512-token runtime resource cap is not an answer word or paragraph target; M7 later validates answer grounding and citations.
runtime_cases.determinism: The serialized packet and fixed temperature 0, top-p 1, top-k 1, and seed 0 are deterministic. This task does not assert byte-identical neural output across runtime releases.
runtime_cases.context: Before worker invocation M5 EvidencePacker admits only current, citable same-locale JSON Lines within its exact 2,048-token budget. A packet outside worker byte/input limits is rejected; evidence text is never silently truncated by the worker.
runtime_cases.lifecycle: Focused tests prove cancellation, timeout, unload, one-active-generation, invalid artifacts, and disabled/no-model states without a second real-model benchmark.

fallback.rule: Every unavailable worker state reports assistant_ready false and lexical_search_ready true. It neither starts a model nor changes the existing lexical documentation search or core /health/ready.

real_probe.output: Ignored digest-only report under documentation/.cache/bpm093-m6-07/. The runner emits factual flushed stdout progress by locale and never writes prompts or model output to its report.
real_probe.network: No network request, ordinary-search call, retrieval call, browser route, or listener is made.
